adjudication.rationale: The finding identifies a real architectural concern in the diff. Looking at lib/topic_retriever.rb:41, the perform_retrieve method calls Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({}) which processes ALL RSS items (as seen in app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb lines 27-35 where it iterates through rss.items.each). The throttle in retrieved_recently? (lines 24-32) is per-URL based on 'retrieved:#{@embed_url}', so each unique embed URL that triggers retrieval will execute the full RSS import. This is a legitimate scalability/architecture concern - multiple distinct page embeds could cause redundant full feed processing. However, this is not strictly a bug since the system will still function correctly, just inefficiently.
